description: Look up a published Mappu audio guide to a landmark or place. Send query with the landmark's name, or path with a guide path from an earlier Mappu result (an audio-guide result of mappu_search_public_travel or a stop of mappu_find_walks), such as /audio-guides/italy/rome/colosseum. Returns the guide page link, city, listening minutes, available languages, its sections in order, the venue's official website where Mappu has checked it, the walks that include it and a short description. The audio plays in Mappu, not in the chat.

path.description: Exact public guide path from a previous Mappu result, not a URL.

name: mappu_get_audio_guide
title: Get an audio guide
